# Test fixtures

- `nikon_d1.NEF` — real Nikon D1 RAW file from [raw.pixls.us](https://raw.pixls.us/data/Nikon/D1/)
  (RAW samples published there under CC0 1.0). Used by the RAW / critical master
  integration tests so NEF support is exercised end-to-end with LibRaw.

JPEG, PNG and MP4 fixtures are generated at test time (sharp / FFmpeg).
